data.name: Secret World Legends
data.detailed_description:
Secret World Legends is a story-driven, shared-world action RPG that plunges players into a shadowy war against the supernatural, where ancient myths and legends cross over into the modern day. Armed with both weapons and superhuman abilities, you will build your powers, solve deep mysteries, and destroy terrifying evils to uncover a dark and captivating storyline that traverses the globe. Can you reveal the truth?

Features

  • Fight in a Secret War against the Supernatural: Where will you stand in the secret war between good and evil as supernatural forces threaten the modern-day world? Use a wide range of weapons and superhuman abilities to destroy the sinister evils that are threatening humanity’s existence.

  • Unravel the Mysteries of the Legends: Dive into the innovative Investigation Missions, where your wits are as important as your skills. Solve mysteries while battling evil in unique missions and quests never before seen in a game of its kind.

  • Descend into a Dark, Mature Storyline: Secret World Legends brings storytelling to a new level by dropping you into the heart of a dramatic and chill-inducing narrative filled with unique missions, emotional punches, and mysterious Legends, brought to life by high-quality voice-acting throughout the adventure.

  • Explore the Secret World: Travel from London to Seoul to New York and beyond. Explore the dark forests of Transylvania, the scorched deserts of Egypt, and a small coastal town in New England filled with horror and mystery. Visit locations inspired by the real world now invaded by creatures of myth and legend.

  • Deep Character Customization: Choose from hundreds of different customization options for your character, from a deep arsenal of weapons, extensive gear and clothing, to a vast set of supernatural powers and augmentations.

  • 100+ Hours of Free Stories and Gameplay: Play for free--all of the game’s 100+ hours of missions and quests are completely free to play.

  • Play Solo or With Your Friends: The entire storyline is available to play through on your own, or team up in a seamless multiplayer experience where players from across the globe can adventure together.

reviews.review:
TL;DR: I give this game a 3/5 over all. I don't recommend it because its dead. You can solo it for the story, which is really quite good if you don't care about the social aspect of MMOs. That's the only reason I am playing it and the only reason I'm giving it a 3. Combat is lack luster and there are bugs and jank that probably won't be fixed.

Full Review:
This game is really interesting. The story, lore, and atmosphere is fascinating and the investigation missions are unlike anything I've played in a game. You have to actually find clues to a lot of those things on the internet and other places, like an ARG. I have never played a game that had that kind of meta aspect to it. Makes you feel like a conspiracy nut, which really adds to the immersion given the premise of the game. The character monologues and stuff are really well written too. I imagine that this was quiet the experience in its hay-day.

But why don't I recommend this game? Well it's dead. The player-base is pretty much non-existent. I have over 30 hours so far in this game and I've seen maybe 5 or 6 people total, and they are probably replaying the story. That's not really a huge problem seeing as you can solo the majority of the game. The quests and story missions are designed to accommodate solo play and the dungeons are doable if you over-level and decrease the difficulty before doing them. But unless you are purposefully playing this game with your own friends or happen upon someone in game who is interested in playing together, you can pretty much forget about any of the social aspects of the MMO. That ship has sailed.

The combat also isn't very good. It's a little more active than other MMOs, but it's nothing to write home about. It feels like it was over-streamlined, so you don't really feel the need to think about it much save for an occasional dodge. Beyond that, everything seems to just boil down to hit it until its dead save for boss fights, which are a little more interesting, but not by much.

The age of the game also means it is abandoned. I suspect there won't be any updates or fixes and this can cause issues with playing the game as intended. There is a built in web-browser in the game meant for those investigation missions and unless its a fake site for the game, you aren't going to be able to use it at all for those missions because it doesn't work. This means you'll have to either use an external browser and resources if you want to figure those missions out yourself, or just look up a guide. There is also some jank that I doubt will be patched. Invisible enemies, dialogue bugs, UI & animation bugs in combat. I haven't run into that much of them but when they do happen, it messes you up. I also heard that the game's story has a distinct feeling of being unfinished after setting up the next major arc of the world. Like a show that had a good, wrapped up season 1 but was cancelled in the midst of season 2.
